externalStorageReference.rationale: Outside Git. Not L: (direct writes forbidden; Hub apply-ingest gated materialIngestApplyAuthorized=false). Not Z: (AI-Cache-Authority single-writer rule CAD-20260802-z-ai-cache-single-canonical-authority; wrong purpose). Operator-approved location for the raw evidence store.

integrity.perFileProof: Every source file hashed before and after copy; preserved copy re-hashed and compared. All 502 matched.
integrity.independentSpotCheck: 6 randomly selected files re-hashed from live source and preserved copy after the run; all matched the manifest.

sourceMutation.statement: No file under any source root was created, modified, moved, or deleted. Access was read-only (stat, read, hash).

secretHandling: No transcript content parsed, printed, or logged. Destination is 0700/0400. Secret scanning is deliberately NOT performed here -- it belongs to Phase 2 ingestion, not to emergency preservation.
